about.title: Engineering from Gaza, for teams anywhere.
paragraphs: I am a software engineer working across the whole stack: the product surface people touch, the services behind it, and the cloud it runs on. Most of my current work is AI-native — LLM orchestration, retrieval, and the unglamorous plumbing that makes a model useful inside a real enterprise system.

I work remotely with distributed teams and consult for clients across the US. For years I also taught what I know — mentoring developers through Gaza Sky Geeks and running front-end training. Building from Gaza has made me pragmatic about constraints: unreliable power and connectivity are a good teacher for writing resilient systems.

life.title: The road here
life.intro: Photographs from the years behind the work — where things started and what they turned into.

entries.title: University, and the friends I found there
entries.caption: My first days at university, where I met the friends who mattered. The best of them was Yasser Arafat Al-Tartouri. He was killed in the war.

entries.title: Where it really started
entries.caption: The day I went and rented a desk at the Gaza Sky Geeks coworking space. That is where my real programming journey began.

entries.title: GSG Code Academy
entries.caption: I took the Full-Stack JavaScript Engineering training at the GSG Code Academy.

entries.title: From trainee to instructor
entries.caption: After finishing the training I came back as a Full-Stack instructor, teaching four trainees of my own — C.A-Team 7, June 2023.

entries.title: Good times at the GSG workspace
entries.caption: Beautiful moments at the Gaza Sky Geeks workspace — the corridor, the coffee table, the desks, a day at the beach with everyone, and a selfie at the GSG hub.

entries.title: The Metafore team

entries.title: Nature, animals, and the family farm
entries.caption: Away from the screen: I love nature and animals, and the family farm is where I go back to.

entries.title: Green places

entries.title: Vladimir
entries.caption: I had a pet, and his name was Vladimir. 😄

entries.title: Where I am now
